description: Baseline contract scenarios the differential runner compares between Python and .NET backends. Each scenario fires the same (METHOD, path, auth, body) at both URLs and diffs status, compareHeaders subset, and normalised body. Add a new scenario here when a new operation lands in both backends; OpenApiInventoryTests and InternalApiContractTests cover the broader inventory parity separately.

scenarios.name: health-probe
scenarios.notes: The single health probe the Stage 5 plan pins to /api/health; the Dockerfile and Compose must not regress to /health.

scenarios.name: knowledge-list-authenticated
scenarios.notes: Owner-session list. The runner sends a session cookie it bootstraps against the same fixture dataset on both backends.

scenarios.name: ontology-get-authenticated
scenarios.notes: Reads the TBox for the seeded knowledge system. Dynamic fields (etag, updated_at) are stripped via the normalization allowlist.

scenarios.name: auth-me-authenticated
scenarios.notes: The session-validated identity probe. response.id is a stable fixture value; any *_token fields are stripped by the normaliser before diffing.

scenarios.name: auth-me-unauthenticated
scenarios.notes: Anonymous identity probe. Both backends must return the FastAPI {'detail': '...'} envelope with status 401.
